intro: Where AFTERHAUL is heading, from the first drivable truck to release. Each item shows its status. This is a draft plan: items can move, change or be dropped, and we set dates only when a stage is close.

stages.name: Concept
stages.lead: Planning and groundwork. Nothing is playable yet.

items.title: Game design written
items.text: The whole game, from the first haul to the last region, is on paper.
points: Core loop: contracts, cargo, fuel, repair and a Ledger economy
Driver body, needs, injury and rescue rules
Eight driver classes, each with a skill tree
Host-run crews with three access levels and hiring from a session browser
Mod format: data mods and sandboxed script mods

items.title: Core rules written and tested
items.text: Trucks, weather, hunger and thirst, clothing and truck parts all have working rules.
points: Drivetrain: engine, clutch, gearbox, driveshaft, heat and coolant
Weather states, seasons and ground surface tables
Mass, cargo slots and spill rules
Needs, stamina and effort models
Clothing layers and truck mount rules, validated from data files

items.title: Website and player guide
items.text: You are looking at it. The guide grows with the game.
points: Player guide built from the design source, so it cannot drift
Changelog and roadmap generated from data files
Logo kit, release stages and patch types
No trackers; video loads only when played

items.title: First drivable truck
items.text: One truck on a test field, with real weight, steering and engine behaviour.
points: Custom vehicle model on top of the physics engine: per-wheel suspension and load transfer
Steering force from ground and wheel load, with force-feedback wheel support
Drivetrain wired to physics: clutch slip, shifts and stalls
Cab spring and damping
Dashboard and in-cab tablet readouts

items.title: First driver
items.text: A body that moves with its own muscles, falls and gets back up, and can be dressed.
points: Active ragdoll: rigid bodies joined by motors, poses set by code
State machine: standing, stumbling, falling, getting up
Hands and feet reach targets: wheel, shifter, pedals
Ten clothing slots and five body types on one shared rig
Character creation from fixed options with a small adjustable range

stages.name: Alpha
stages.lead: The first playable version. Rough, small and for invited testers.

items.title: Small crews in one truck
items.text: A few players share a truck, with voice chat and a host who runs the session.
points: Host-authoritative sessions: the Operations Chief runs the world
Full physical bodies up close, cheaper approximations at distance
Proximity voice with range and weather effects
Solo, friends-only and invite-only sessions
World save owned by the host, player profile owned by the player

items.title: First region and first contracts
items.text: One region to cross, with cargo to haul, fuel to find, and damage to repair.
points: Land generated from a seed: terrain, water and forests
Surface types with ruts and soft ground
Contracts with cargo, payout and risk
Fuel, damage zones and garage repairs
Cargo in slots, with mass and securing

items.title: Real gameplay on this site
items.text: Footage from the game replaces the placeholder animations here.
points: Capture in-engine footage to replace the placeholder scenes
Update the stage text and screenshots to match
Keep the placeholder notice until the swap is done

items.title: Closed tests
items.text: Invited players on many kinds of computers, Linux included, report what breaks.
points: Frame-time reporting built into test builds
Hardware survey: CPU, GPU, memory, Windows and Linux through Proton
Host-role tests across different machines
Bug reports through a simple form
Privacy notice for tester data

stages.name: Beta
stages.lead: Most of the game is in. More players try it and help shape it.

items.title: More regions
items.text: The rest of the land opens up, each with its own ground and weather.
points: Remaining regions with their own ground, trees and hazards
Water crossings: bridges, fords and ice
Region-specific employers and jobs
Rebuild progress kept in the world save
Municipal services in settled areas

items.title: Weather and seasons
items.text: Storms, snow and heat change how you drive and what you wear.
points: Eight weather states from clear to blizzard and sandstorm
Seasons on a real-week cycle: four weeks make a year
Snow build-up, packing and loss of traction
Cold exposure, frozen trucks and rescue calls
Weather effects on sound, voice and radio range

items.title: Driver classes
items.text: All eight classes, with their own skills and truck parts.
points: Eight classes, each with its own skill tree
Class parts on the truck: medical bay, kitchen, winch, crane and racks
Role-based contracts and payouts
Crew balance tuned for eight

items.title: A living economy
items.text: Prices, jobs and rebuilding that change as the world recovers.
points: A Ledger of jobs and aid (tow, rescue, repair) paid between players
Employers with regional contracts and risk-based payouts
Truck stops and diners for food, fuel and repairs
Dynamic and seasonal world events

items.title: Full crews of eight
items.text: Eight players and eight trucks, tuned until it runs smoothly.
points: Frame budget per system: physics, character, audio, voice, rendering
Distant players on cheaper bodies; the local player is never degraded
Shader prewarm and terrain streaming to avoid hitches
No allocations in hot paths; objects pooled
Tested with eight players and eight trucks from early on

items.title: Beta on Steam
items.text: Open to more players, with fixes shipped as patches and listed in the changelog.
points: Windows build checked under Proton
No kernel anti-cheat and no custom launcher
Fixes shipped as patches, each listed in the changelog
Beta feedback fed back into the roadmap

stages.name: Release
stages.lead: The finished first version, ready for everyone.

items.title: The full campaign
items.text: From the first delivery to the front line, polished.
points: A campaign from the first delivery to the front line of Drennmark
Employers and characters you meet along the way
Side quests
Balance and polish pass
Versioned, checksummed saves with a backup copy

items.title: Modding
items.text: Build a truck or a change and share it. A truck is one folder of files.
points: A mod is a folder with a manifest; data mods merge by id
Script mods run in a Lua sandbox and turn achievements off
The same mod set is required for everyone in a session
A checker tool validates a mod before it is shared
Mod portal: not yet decided

items.title: Later regions as free updates
items.text: More of the land arrives after release.
points: Remaining regions released after launch
Native Linux build planned after release
Community wiki linking to the official guide
Player-made designs through a verified site, later
